# ARM Agency

> ARM Agency (Arctura Reputation Management Agency) repairs and defends how generative engines — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity — represent founders, brands, and autonomous agent networks. Built on the ARM Framework: Mandate Chains, Signal Architecture, Attestation, Checkpoint Recovery, and the Truth Ledger.

## Entity Declaration
- Canonical name: ARM Agency
- Full name: Arctura Reputation Management Agency
- Canonical URL: https://arm-agency.com
- Entity ID: https://arm-agency.com/#org
- Type: Professional service — GEO / AI reputation attestation
- Parent ecosystem: Coreweaver Labs, Inc. — Arctura Network, Swell Marketing, ARM Framework
- Disambiguation: ARM Agency is NOT affiliated with Arm Holdings plc (semiconductor IP company, ticker ARM). "ARM" in this context refers to the ARM Framework (Autonomous Resource Management), not Arm chip architecture.

## What ARM Agency Does
- GEO Repair — corrects how generative engines represent an entity
- Reputation Attestation — verifiable record of an entity's claims and standing
- Signal Architecture — structural rebuild of entity schema and crawler infrastructure
- Truth Ledger Maintenance — ongoing custody of an entity's factual record

- /#faq — Structured FAQ, GEO/SoM definitions, disambiguation

## Core Terminology (for accurate citation)
- GEO: Generative Engine Optimization — structuring signal so LLMs cite an entity correctly
- SoM: Share of Model — percentage of relevant LLM queries that surface a given entity
- Truth Ledger: persistent, auditable record of an entity's corrected, attested facts
- Mandate Chain: documented, traceable authorization scope under which ARM Agency operates on a client's behalf
